consent.definition: Everyone agreeing freely to something, every time. A clear no is a complete answer that needs no follow-up.
consent.example: Consent has to be clear on both sides, and a no is always a complete answer.

dual_means.definition: The way an aim is carried out: the tools, the words and the methods used.
dual_means.example: The means were ordinary tools used in an ordinary way.

enamel.definition: The hard outer coat of a tooth. It is the hardest part of your body.
enamel.example: The enamel is the shiny white part you can see.

unit_economics.definition: The revenue and cost attached to one unit of a product — the arithmetic of whether a business model works.
